deploybot: created tag stable-2026.03.11 for `inference-runtime` at commit 4f3a9c2

- batching: dynamic threshold tuning for lower p50 latency
- quant: added int8 fallback profile for A100 (safe fallback on regressions)
- infra: upgraded aten kernels (minor)
- docs: rollout notes + pinning guide for Dedicated customers

sara: Any DB/schema migrations here? should we delay?

marco: Canary metrics to watch? baseline for success/fail?
olivia: Watch p50/p95 latency, token throughput, OOM counts, and KV cache miss rate.
If OOM rate > 0.1% or p95 > 800ms sustained for 5m -> abort canary and rollback.
aaron: I'll draft the status page update and customer note. ETA 30m.
tim: For Dedicated customers we should recommend pinning to `stable-2026.03.11` before next maintenance window. I'll coordinate with account SAs.

```bash
kubectl set image deployment/inference inference=registry.redwood.io/inference:stable-2026.03.10 -n production
# or use rollout undo
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference -n production
```
marco: I'll start the canary monitors (latency + OOM + kv-miss) and post a quick dashboard link when live.
